KamiCreative 1.2.0 makes visuals react to sound, like photism: seeing the music as light and colour.

## Download

**KamiCreative-Setup-1.2.0.exe** below — Windows 10/11, 64-bit. Run it, choose where to install, and start KamiCreative from the Start menu or desktop. The installer is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may ask you to confirm: choose **More info → Run anyway**.

## New in 1.2.0

- **Listen to anything.** Click the new **Sound** button to choose your microphone or everything your computer is playing (Spotify, YouTube, a DJ app), or play a song inside KamiCreative.
- **React to sound with a right-click.** Any number on any module can follow the bass, mids, treble, loudness or beat. Set how far it moves and how smoothly.
- **Sound Visualizer** with eight styles: bars, mirror bars, circle, waveform, ring wave, tunnel, stars and blob.
- **Colour Organ**: each part of the music glows its own colour, low notes red through high notes violet.
- **Sound Pulse**: makes any video zoom, flash, shake and shift colour with the beat.
- **Beat and tempo detection**, and scenes that change by themselves every few beats.
- New recipes (Music visualizer, Colour organ, Make a video dance), a Music Visuals example show, and a tutorial step on sound.

See the [changelog](https://github.com/terpenesalad/kamicreative/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) and the [Sound and music](https://github.com/terpenesalad/kamicreative/blob/main/docs/USER_GUIDE.md#sound-and-music) section of the user guide.
